children: RNS Number : 1104E  Dotlines Global Limited  20 November 2026
Issue of equity and total voting rights

Dotlines (AIM: DOTL), the UK-based international technology group with operations across the UK and Southeast Asia spanning telecommunications, digital infrastructure, cybersecurity and financial technology, announces that as agreed at the time of the Company’s admission to AIM (“Admission”) it will issue 398,309 new ordinary shares of no par value in the Company (“Ordinary Shares”) to Kane Black, a former director of the Company (the “Accrual Shares”).

As set out in the Company’s AIM admission document dated 20 April 2026 (the “Admission Document”) and subject to a deed of indemnity provided by Mr Black, the Accrual Shares would be issued six months following Admission at 9.5 pence per share in satisfaction of director fees and expenses incurred prior to Admission.

Mr Black has agreed that, for a period of six months from the date of issue, he will not dispose of any of the Accrual Shares except in accordance with certain orderly market principles, subject to certain exceptions.

The Company will now proceed to issue the Accrual Shares and application has been made to the London Stock Exchange for the 398,309 Accrual Shares to be admitted to trading on AIM on or around 24 November 2026 (“Accrual Shares Admission”). The Accrual Shares will rank pari passu in all respects with the Company’s existing Ordinary Shares.

Following Accrual Shares Admission, the issued share capital of the Company will comprise 610,567,984 Ordinary Shares. Each Ordinary Share has one voting right and no Ordinary Shares are held in treasury. Accordingly, from the date of Accrual Shares Admission, the total number of voting rights in the Company will be 610,567,984. This figure may be used by shareholders as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, the Company under the Financial Conduct Authority’s Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
Allenby Capital Limited (Nominated Adviser and Broker)
Jos Pinnington/Lauren Wright (Equity Sales & Corporate Broking)

Dotlines Global Ltd (AIM: DOTL) is a UK-based international technology group operating in the telecommunications, digital infrastructure, cybersecurity and financial technology sectors. Founded in Malaysia in 2007 as a bespoke B2B software development business, it has since grown to offer a range of products, platforms and solutions for both B2B and B2C customers. Its two core areas of activity are digital content and services – principally, the Sohoj digital lifestyle platform for migrant populations in Malaysia, which has served over a million migrants from countries across Asia – and telecom products and services in the UK comprising: the Catena OSS and BSS software platform for internet service providers; Audra SME- and consumer-focused cybersecurity solutions; and the Carnival Internet full fibre broadband service.
